title: Tour de France Boss Rejects Radical Idea to Cut Race to Two Weeks
content:
Reducing the grand tours to make way for the UCI calendar reforms? Prudhomme defends the Tour’s format, and the Giro and Vuelta bosses aren’t giving up race days either.

Read the full article at Tour de France Boss Rejects Radical Idea to Cut Race to Two Weeks on Velo.
author: ahood
